population: Public GitHub repositories carrying at least one of the seed topics, as returned by the GitHub search API on the seed date, ordered by stars. The seed responses are snapshotted and committed, so selection is reproducible after star counts move.
dedupe: one repository per owner: the highest-starred stays; the rest are excluded as duplicate-owner
stop_rule: Walk the ordered candidate list until 50 pages are snapshotted. If the list is exhausted first, publish the achieved n and never pad.

exclusions.awesome-list: name matches /^awesome[-_]/i, or topics include awesome-list or awesome
exclusions.duplicate-owner: another repository from the same owner ranks higher
exclusions.no-quickstart-found: no probe in probe_order yields a page
exclusions.render-blocked: the page text is shorter than 500 characters or has no fenced code block, and no raw-markdown fallback exists
exclusions.fetch-failed: every probe failed: unsafe URL, timeout, network error, or non-2xx

probe_order.rule: repo.homepage is http(s) and its host is not github.com. Fetch it. The first <a> whose visible text matches text_re wins; resolve its href against the homepage URL. The target host must equal the homepage host, or be github.com/<owner>/<repo>.
On the homepage origin, try these paths in order; the first 2xx wins.

Fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/HEAD/README.md. The first ATX heading of any level whose text matches text_re wins. The page is that section, from the heading to the next heading of the same or higher level.

quickstart.render_blocked_fallback: If the page is render-blocked, follow the page's own 'edit this page' link matching /github\.com\/[^\s"']+\/(?:edit|blob)\/[^\s"']+\.mdx?/ as raw markdown. If none exists, exclude as render-blocked.

fetch.guard: packages/shared safeFetch: SSRF guard, every redirect hop re-validated

coverage_gap: Closed API vendors enter the corpus only through an official SDK repository carrying a seed topic. That is the price of a mechanical rule and is stated in the report.
